​
The third and fourth phases of the IRGC’s retaliatory operation targeted US military bases in Kuwait.

“In the third phase of its retaliatory operation in response to the US aggression, the IRGC Aerospace Force completely destroyed fuel storage tanks and a Patriot air defense system at the US base in Kuwait’s Ali Al Salem as well as an FPS strategic radar system at Ahmad Al Jaber Air Base.”

In the fourth phase, according to the IRGC, its Ground Force targeted a US Army surface-to-surface missile base in Kuwait, setting two HIMARS missile launchers and ammunition depots stocked with missiles on fire before completely destroying them.
​
The IRGC emphasized that the Strait of Hormuz is Iranian territory and that “we will not allow a rogue, child-killing army from the other side of the world to continue its illegal interference there.”
